court: U.S. District Court, Southern District of New York
claim_type: Sweetgreen's online ordering system and mobile app inaccessible to blind users
outcome: Settled — Sweetgreen required to remediate website and app to WCAG 2.0 AA by March 31, 2017; monetary terms confidential

sources.name: Settlement document — Farmer v. Sweetgreen, Inc. (S.D.N.Y.)
National Restaurant News — New lawsuit against Sweetgreen (2024 repeat)
Equal Entry — Accessibility lawsuit against Sweetgreen

summary_one_line: Sweetgreen settled in 2016 requiring WCAG 2.0 AA compliance — then was sued again in 2024 (Colak v. Sweetgreen, E.D.N.Y. 2:24-cv-00198) for the same violations, settled May 2024.
notes: Sweetgreen was sued twice: 2016 (settled, required remediation) and again January 2024 (Colak v. Sweetgreen, Case No. 2:24-cv-00198, E.D.N.Y., settled May 2024 for undisclosed amount). The repeat lawsuit pattern is compelling sales evidence: settling once and doing nothing is not a solution.
